items.quote: I moved to a new city for my studies and didn't know anyone. After my first Appro on Bonfiire, I had a group to hang out with every weekend.
items.name: Sample Student

items.quote: We used to run our Appro with three WhatsApp groups and a spreadsheet. This year the route, the checkpoints and the chat all lived in one app.
items.name: Sample Organizer

items.quote: The event album is my favourite part. All the photos from the night in one place, not lost in someone's camera roll.
items.name: Sample Student
